main_text.l: nunmehr erwehlen / und zu was Stand er sich
Philosophen und Oratorn je und allweg für
die schwereste und wichtigste/und solches nit
andern/auß dem Exempel Herculis in bivio constituti,
davon Cicero und andere Scribenten melden/fast
jederman kundt und offenbar ist. So seynd
welche von deß h. Pirck. eigen hand abcopiirt/
und nit unwürdig geachtet sein/daß sie mit dieser

l.i: Quem Vita cursum teneat quisquam ? omnia tandem
Aut labor, aut metus, aut cura perennis
habet, Diffundit turpes temeraria concio voces,
Assiduus vincit vix tamen arva labor.
Divitiis metus est, casus ne perdat acerbus:
Si nihil est, dolet hoc jam nihil esse domi.
Nupseris? aerumna comites sine fine sequuntur:
At sine coniugio est dimidiata domus.

page.notes: The first word of the epigram is a large initial Q, transcribed as "Quem". The catchword "Si tibi" at the right foot is in italic type and is given only as a catchword. Possible doubtful readings: "be-geben" (line-end hyphen after "be") and "Nautas" (final letter). Spelling of the Latin verse follows the scan, with u/v and i/j normalised. Printed "Clamosoq;" and "quisquam ?" are kept as printed.
